Canadian canoe is an active and dynamic way to paddle using a single-blade paddle, gliding smoothly across the water. Learn steering and control techniques while enjoying the experience.

【Fee】 ¥3,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, and canoe rental)

【Capacity】 5 people

【Guide】 Staff from Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to Bring】 Drinking water (vending machine available at the workshop), sun protection items such as hat or sunglasses as needed

【Note】 Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
